_comment: Fixture stand-in for the model catalog Codex normally fetches from its own API and caches at $CODEX_HOME/models_cache.json. The e2e stack runs with no network, so nothing would ever write this file — and without it a codexOverrides preset cannot derive its catalog entry (see src/sdk/src/codex_overrides/catalog.rs) and the run fails before it reaches the mock LLM. Only the fields that derivation reads or Codex requires are present, and the instructions template is a deliberately short stand-in rather than a copy of the vendor's system prompt.

models.description: Template entry the e2e harness derives its routed model from.

supported_reasoning_levels.description: Greater reasoning depth for complex problems

model_messages.instructions_template: You are Codex, a coding agent running under the Medulla end-to-end harness. Answer the user's request directly.
